name: Super-Entropic Black Holes
convention: The anti-de Sitter radius $\ell$ and the mass parameter $m$ are lengths, with $\Lambda = -3/\ell^2$, and the azimuthal coordinate is periodic with period $\mu$, a pure number. We keep factors of $c$ explicit.

coordinates.name: Hennigar-Kubizňák-Mann

parameters.description: The anti-de Sitter radius, a length, with $\Lambda = -3/\ell^2$; it is also the rotation parameter, since the hole spins at $a = \ell$
Mass parameter, a length; the mass is $M = \mu m c^2/(2\pi G)$ and the angular momentum $J = M\ell c$
Equal to $r^2 + \ell^2$ near the poles and to $r^2$ on the equator
A quartic in $r$ whose two positive roots $r_- \le r_+$ are the horizons, which exist for $m \ge 8\ell/(3\sqrt{3})$

coordinates.convention: We use the coordinates $(t, r, \theta, \psi)$ of Hennigar, Kubizňák, and Mann, with $t$ carrying dimensions of time and $\psi$ periodic in $\mu$, and write $\Sigma$ and $\Delta$ as the parameters define them. We take components in the chart $x^0 = ct$, and a dot in the geodesic equations is a derivative with respect to an affine parameter, so $\dot{t}$ means $d(ct)/d\lambda$.

coordinates.name: Carter-Plebański

parameters.description: The anti-de Sitter radius, a length, with $\Lambda = -3/\ell^2$
Mass parameter, a length; the mass is $M = \mu m c^2/(2\pi G)$
The quartic in $q$ whose largest root $q_+$ is the event horizon
The quartic in $p$ with a double root at each pole, $p = \pm\ell$

coordinates.convention: We use the coordinates $(\tau, q, p, \sigma)$ of Carter and Plebański's metric as Klemm writes it, with $\tau$ carrying dimensions of time, $q$ and $p$ lengths, and $\sigma$ an inverse length periodic in $\mu/\ell$, and write $Q$ and $P$ as the parameters define them. We take components in the chart $x^0 = c\tau$, and a dot in the geodesic equations is a derivative with respect to an affine parameter, so $\dot{\tau}$ means $d(c\tau)/d\lambda$.
coordinates.line_element: ds^2 = -\dfrac{Q}{q^2 + p^2}\left(c\,d\tau + \left(\ell^2 - p^2\right)d\sigma\right)^2 + \dfrac{q^2 + p^2}{Q}dq^2 + \dfrac{q^2 + p^2}{P}dp^2 + \dfrac{P}{q^2 + p^2}\left(c\,d\tau + \left(\ell^2 + q^2\right)d\sigma\right)^2
geodesics: \ddot{\tau} + \dfrac{2\left(q^2 + \ell^2\right)\left(q\left(q^2 + p^2\right)^2 + \ell^2\,m\left(q^2 - p^2\right)\right)}{\ell^2\,Q\left(q^2 + p^2\right)^2}\dot{\tau}\dot{q} - \dfrac{2p\left(\left(q^2 + p^2\right)^2 - 2\ell^2\,m\,q\right)}{\left(q^2 + p^2\right)^2\left(\ell^2 - p^2\right)}\dot{\tau}\dot{p} + \dfrac{2m\left(\ell^2 - p^2\right)\left(3q^4 + \ell^2\,q^2 + q^2\,p^2 - \ell^2\,p^2\right)}{Q\left(q^2 + p^2\right)^2}\dot{q}\dot{\sigma} + \dfrac{4\ell^2\,m\,q\,p}{\left(q^2 + p^2\right)^2}\dot{p}\dot{\sigma} = 0

\ddot{q} + \dfrac{Q\left(q\left(q^2 + p^2\right)^2 + \ell^2\,m\left(q^2 - p^2\right)\right)}{\ell^2\left(q^2 + p^2\right)^3}\dot{\tau}^2 + \dfrac{2Q\left(\ell^2 - p^2\right)\left(q\left(q^2 + p^2\right)^2 + \ell^2\,m\left(q^2 - p^2\right)\right)}{\ell^2\left(q^2 + p^2\right)^3}\dot{\tau}\dot{\sigma} - \dfrac{q\left(q^2 + \ell^2\right)\left(q^2 - \ell^2 + 2p^2\right) + \ell^2\,m\left(q^2 - p^2\right)}{\ell^2\,Q\left(q^2 + p^2\right)}\dot{q}^2 + \dfrac{2p}{q^2 + p^2}\dot{q}\dot{p} - \dfrac{\ell^2\,q\,Q}{\left(q^2 + p^2\right)\left(\ell^2 - p^2\right)^2}\dot{p}^2 + \dfrac{m\,Q\left(\ell^2 - p^2\right)^2\left(q^2 - p^2\right)}{\left(q^2 + p^2\right)^3}\dot{\sigma}^2 = 0

\ddot{p} - \dfrac{p\left(\ell^2 - p^2\right)^2\left(\left(q^2 + p^2\right)^2 - 2\ell^2\,m\,q\right)}{\ell^4\left(q^2 + p^2\right)^3}\dot{\tau}^2 - \dfrac{2p\left(\ell^2 - p^2\right)^2\left(q^2 + \ell^2\right)\left(\left(q^2 + p^2\right)^2 - 2\ell^2\,m\,q\right)}{\ell^4\left(q^2 + p^2\right)^3}\dot{\tau}\dot{\sigma} - \dfrac{p\left(\ell^2 - p^2\right)^2}{\ell^2\,Q\left(q^2 + p^2\right)}\dot{q}^2 + \dfrac{2q}{q^2 + p^2}\dot{q}\dot{p} + \dfrac{p\left(2q^2 + \ell^2 + p^2\right)}{\left(q^2 + p^2\right)\left(\ell^2 - p^2\right)}\dot{p}^2 + \dfrac{2m\,q\,p\left(\ell^2 - p^2\right)^3\left(2q^2 + \ell^2 + p^2\right)}{\ell^2\left(q^2 + p^2\right)^3}\dot{\sigma}^2 = 0

\ddot{\sigma} - \dfrac{2q\left(q^2 + p^2\right)^2 + 2\ell^2\,m\left(q^2 - p^2\right)}{\ell^2\,Q\left(q^2 + p^2\right)^2}\dot{\tau}\dot{q} + \dfrac{2p\left(\left(q^2 + p^2\right)^2 - 2\ell^2\,m\,q\right)}{\left(q^2 + p^2\right)^2\left(\ell^2 - p^2\right)^2}\dot{\tau}\dot{p} + \dfrac{2q\left(q^2 + p^2\right)^2\left(q^2 + \ell^2\right) - 2\ell^2\,m\left(2q^4 + \ell^2\,q^2 + q^2\,p^2 - \ell^2\,p^2 + p^4\right)}{\ell^2\,Q\left(q^2 + p^2\right)^2}\dot{q}\dot{\sigma} - \dfrac{2p\left(\left(q^2 + p^2\right)^2 + 2\ell^2\,m\,q\right)}{\left(q^2 + p^2\right)^2\left(\ell^2 - p^2\right)}\dot{p}\dot{\sigma} = 0
